body.title: Project sequenceDefinition through sc1 and rebuild the daemon
body.summary: Land the approved amendment AMD-bfe98ff7f97178cf-1: add `sequenceDefinition?: SequenceDefinition | undefined` to ArtifactReviewView beside its four siblings (artifact-content.ts:63-66) and one conditional-spread line in structuredRecords (:203-215), in exactly the shape the existing four use so absence stays an ABSENT KEY. Mirror it on DocsContent (docs-review-client.ts:34-37) INDEXED off the daemon type rather than restated. componentDependencyDefinition is explicitly NOT added (0 producer bodies). This is the ONLY task that changes a file under src/, so the daemon must be rebuilt — and the live end-to-end confirmation is recorded as a MANUAL check, not as something the build gate can attest, because that sandbox cannot execute anything.
acceptanceChecks: RUNNABLE IN-PROCESS: a unit test calls structuredRecords directly over the REAL ledger body .insrc/artifacts/LLD-bfe98ff7f97178cf-s2.json and asserts sequenceDefinition comes back VERBATIM (deep-equal to the body's own value, not merely present)
RUNNABLE IN-PROCESS: a body WITHOUT the field yields a response with no such key — asserted as `'sequenceDefinition' in view === false`, never a null/falsy check
DocsContent's field is written as `ArtifactReviewView['sequenceDefinition']` rather than restated, matching the four shipped siblings so the shapes cannot drift

ADDITIVE-ONLY, stated deliberately for the cross-repo mirror: every new field optional, absence an absent key, and NO existing field of ArtifactReviewView changed in name, type or meaning — so the insrc-ide fork, which mirrors this IPC payload shape, needs no coordinated change. Provable by diffing the interface; the conclusion is recorded in the task note so a future reader sees the mirror was considered, not missed

MANUAL, recorded not attested: after `daemon-ctl.sh update`/rebuild, one real document carrying a sequenceDefinition is opened through the live daemon and the field is confirmed to arrive. The result is written into the task note, explicitly flagged as a manual verification the gate did not run

tests.name: structuredRecords: projects sequenceDefinition VERBATIM from the real LLD-bfe98ff7f97178cf-s2 body (deep-equal, not merely present)
structuredRecords: a body without sequenceDefinition yields no such key ('sequenceDefinition' in view === false)
structuredRecords: the four pre-existing records project unchanged — no existing field altered in name, type or meaning
DocsContent.sequenceDefinition is indexed off ArtifactReviewView rather than restated
MANUAL post-rebuild: a real sequenceDefinition-carrying document arrives through the live daemon (result recorded in the task note, not gate-attested)
